comment: The Haro v0.8 conformance floor, written BEFORE the court that passes it (the W discipline: fixtures first, prose second). v0.8 grows v0.7 by what F -- the alphabet's F letter, RingFlex's .wflow v0 re-declared (haro/SPIKE.md, the eighth rung) -- needs and nothing else: a REFUSAL that names known trespassers (NAMED: an author who writes FLOW or INVOKED_BY deserves to be told which law they met); a pair list keyed by a MENU (an ordered sequence of actions, keys may repeat) or by a DECLARATION (routing guards, keys resolve), whose values may be references; a UNION of DECLARATIONs (an arrow's target is a step, a terminal or a suspension, told apart by name in one namespace); the shapes duration, landmark and deadline; the WORLD's ENTRY kinds (the first declaration of one of them is where a walk starts); three closed relations -- self reachable (from the entry, through the entry kinds' reference seats), self referenced (named by any reference seat of the sentence), a pair list keyed_by a name list. Every v0.7 fixture still passes: v0.8 refuses nothing v0.7 accepted. Rejects carry the fragment the refusal must contain.

accepts.name: a REFUSAL names known trespassers: NAMED gives a word its own message
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.8", GRAMMAR "0.8", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION step AS (VERB "STEP", SEATS [target: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFUSAL unknown_declaration AS (MESSAGE "the declaration set is closed", NAMED [flow: "'FLOW' belongs to ZQL, not to this language", forever: "'FOREVER' was deleted from the language"]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a pair list keyed by a MENU is an ordered sequence (keys may repeat); keyed by a DECLARATION its keys resolve; a pair's value may be a reference or a UNION of declarations
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.8", GRAMMAR "0.8", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU verbs AS (WORDS [notify, reassign]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION actor AS (VERB "ACTOR", SEATS [role: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION guard AS (VERB "GUARD", SEATS [norm: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION terminal AS (VERB "TERMINAL", SEATS [outcome: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION step AS (VERB "STEP", SEATS [target: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION node AS (OF [step, terminal]) RATIONALE "a target is a step or a terminal, told apart by name"
DEFINE FORM action AS (SEATS [verb: verbs, target: actor]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM branch AS (SEATS [guard: guard, target: node]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION escalation AS (VERB "ESCALATION", SEATS [on_breach: [action]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION routing AS (VERB "ROUTING", SEATS [when: [branch], otherwise: node]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: the shapes duration, landmark and deadline; the WORLD's ENTRY kinds; MESSAGES on a pair-list seat whose keys or values are references
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.8", GRAMMAR "0.8", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT duration AS (SHAPE duration) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT landmark AS (SHAPE landmark) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT deadline AS (SHAPE deadline, MESSAGE "a deadline never reads instance data") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION workflow AS (VERB "WORKFLOW", SEATS [version: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION guard AS (VERB "GUARD", SEATS [norm: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION terminal AS (VERB "TERMINAL", SEATS [outcome: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM branch AS (SEATS [guard: guard, target: terminal]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION task AS (VERB "TASK", SEATS [sla: duration, timeout: deadline, on_timeout: terminal]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION routing AS (VERB "ROUTING", SEATS [when: [branch], otherwise: terminal], MESSAGES [when: "ROUTING {name} branches on '{value}', which is not a declared guard"]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WORLD f AS (ONE [workflow], FIRST workflow, ENTRY [task, routing]) RATIONALE "the first task or routing declared is the entry"

accepts.name: three closed relations: self reachable, self referenced, a pair list keyed_by a name list
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.8", GRAMMAR "0.8", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION guard AS (VERB "GUARD", SEATS [norm: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION terminal AS (VERB "TERMINAL", SEATS [outcome: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM decision AS (SEATS [word: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM route AS (SEATS [decision: name, target: terminal]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION task AS (VERB "TASK", SEATS [decisions: [decision], routes: [route]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WORLD f AS (ENTRY [task]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT dead_task AS (ON task, WHEN "not self reachable", MESSAGE "C6: {name} is unreachable from the entry") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT dead_end AS (ON terminal, WHEN "not self reachable", MESSAGE "C7: {name} is unreachable") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT unused_guard AS (ON guard, WHEN "not self referenced", MESSAGE "C15: {name} is declared and never used") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT routed AS (ON task, WHEN "not routes keyed_by decisions", MESSAGE "C8: {name} routes '{other}' or leaves it unrouted") RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a v0.7 declaration is a v0.8 declaration: v0.7's A1, unchanged
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.7", GRAMMAR "0.7", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION zexpr AS (OPERATORS [or, and, cmp, contains], OPERANDS [number, text, ref], ABSENT missing, EQUALITY value) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE ASK questions AS (FROM [flow], WHERE zexpr, CLAUSES [where, order, limit]) RATIONALE "SELECT * FROM flow [WHERE expr] [ORDER BY field] [LIMIT n]"

rejects.name: NAMED speaks only for unknown_declaration and unknown_seat, the two refusals a trespasser meets
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.8", GRAMMAR "0.8", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFUSAL duplicate_name AS (MESSAGE "x", NAMED [flow: "x"]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: NAMED belongs to unknown_declaration and unknown_seat

rejects.name: a UNION of declarations may not mix a DECLARATION with a MENU: a word would be either
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.8", GRAMMAR "0.8", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU outcomes AS (WORDS [success]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION terminal AS (VERB "TERMINAL", SEATS [outcome: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION target AS (OF [terminal, outcomes]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: reachable and referenced ask about self and nothing else
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.8", GRAMMAR "0.8", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION step AS (VERB "STEP", SEATS [target: step?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WORLD f AS (ENTRY [step]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT dead AS (ON step, WHEN "target reachable", MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: reachable asks whether self is reachable; write self reachable

rejects.name: ENTRY names DECLARATIONs of this language
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.8", GRAMMAR "0.8", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION step AS (VERB "STEP", SEATS [target: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WORLD f AS (ENTRY [river]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: reachable needs an ENTRY: with none declared, no walk can start
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.8", GRAMMAR "0.8", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION step AS (VERB "STEP", SEATS [target: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT dead AS (ON step, WHEN "not self reachable", MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: reachable walks from the WORLD's ENTRY kinds, and none are declared

rejects.name: keyed_by reads a pair list on its left and a name list on its right
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.8", GRAMMAR "0.8", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM decision AS (SEATS [word: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION task AS (VERB "TASK", SEATS [decisions: [decision], timeout: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT routed AS (ON task, WHEN "timeout keyed_by decisions", MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: keyed_by reads a list of pairs on its left

rejects.name: a pair's value may be a reference, never an EXPRESSION (v0.6's R8, kept)
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.8", GRAMMAR "0.8", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION e AS (OPERATORS [cmp], OPERANDS [number, ref]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM pair AS (SEATS [key: name, value: e]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION step AS (VERB "STEP", SEATS [pairs: [pair]]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a shape is one of the menu, and deadline is in it
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE f AS (VERSION "0.8", GRAMMAR "0.8", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".f") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT when AS (SHAPE moment) RATIONALE "x"
